title: Structured Debate
description: Integrate the Unit language to complete a sustained B2 mission about society, media & debate.
objectives: Integrate the Unit language to complete a sustained B2 mission about society, media & debate.

stages.title: Understand meaning and form
stages.instructions: Read the concept, pattern, examples, contrast, common issue, and recap.

blocks.text: The communicative aim of this lesson is to integrate the Unit language to complete a sustained B2 mission about society, media & debate. The central language focus is integrated structured debate review. In the context of society, media & debate, form and meaning work together: first identify the relationship between the ideas, then choose wording that makes that relationship clear to another person. At B2, organize the message so the listener can follow the claim, support, qualification, and practical consequence. Choose collocations and discourse markers that sound natural in professional and social contexts.

blocks.english: This example illustrates media coverage clearly.
blocks.explanation: This model establishes the main communicative move.

blocks.english: We should consider public perception carefully.
blocks.explanation: This model develops or qualifies the message.

blocks.text: Start with the model “This example illustrates media coverage clearly.” It establishes a useful direction for the exchange. The second model, “We should consider public perception carefully.” adds another layer: a reason, implication, contrast, or response. Notice how each complete chunk does a communicative job. Practice replacing one detail while preserving the original grammar, stance, and register. Then connect the revised sentence to a relevant consequence or example instead of changing topic abruptly.

A useful pattern for this lesson is: integrated structured debate review. Use it when the situation genuinely calls for that meaning. Contrast matters: a direct factual statement presents information, while a qualified or hypothetical form changes the speaker's commitment to it. The choice should be driven by evidence, time reference, relationship, and purpose. In listening, pay attention not only to individual words but also to linkers, stress, and the speaker's degree of certainty.

blocks.title: Contrast
blocks.text: Compare a direct statement with language shaped by integrated structured debate review; the intended meaning determines the form.

A common issue is to select an advanced-looking form without maintaining its meaning across the sentence. That can create a mismatch in time, stance, or register. Check three things: what happened or is being proposed, how certain the speaker is, and what response is expected. For structured debate, clarity comes from a coherent message rather than maximum complexity. The later stages recycle the same vocabulary and expressions so that recognition becomes controlled production and then flexible interaction. This sixth Lesson consolidates Lessons 1–5 and introduces no major new grammar. Select among the Unit patterns according to the communicative need.

blocks.title: Common issue
blocks.text: Do not add complexity that changes the time reference, degree of certainty, or relationship with the listener.

stages.title: Listen for meaning and stance
stages.instructions: Listen first, then reveal the text and notice connections, register, and emphasis.

segments.text: To begin with, This example illustrates media coverage clearly. We should consider public perception carefully.
In this situation, We should consider public perception carefully. The discussion highlighted bias.
From another perspective, The discussion highlighted bias. A clear explanation addresses weigh the evidence directly.
More specifically, A clear explanation addresses weigh the evidence directly. The speaker emphasized reach a balanced conclusion.
Even so, The speaker emphasized reach a balanced conclusion. Our response should account for firmly believe.
As a result, Our response should account for firmly believe. This example illustrates contentious issue clearly.
